author: driver
content:
Implemented: added isVolatile field to X86Region, X86_DRAM=false (decompiler-cacheable), MMIO + all SAM_* = true. applyBlockAttrs now runs on every region every invocation so re-runs repair previously-applied programs.

Verified on Ryzen_Zen2_ver_0d15 and Ryzen_Zen2_ver_0d1a (both already had X86 blocks from the prior session): re-running ApplyPspAddressSpaces.java flipped X86_DRAM volatile=true -> false while leaving X86_MMIO + 4 SAM_* blocks volatile=true. Script remains idempotent.

Pre-existing BadDataType IllegalAccessException ERRORs on 0d1a are unrelated (also surfaced in #74 validation runs).
